name: M1A2 SEPv3 Abrams
variant_notes: M1A2 SEPv3 source OBJ (War Thunder extract). Base vehicle: camouflage nets, TUSK ERA tiles and their rails/frames and whip antennas omitted. Loader shield, CROWS and CITV kept. RimThunder reference is its base M1A2 (SEP generation not stated); SEPv3 detail differences are recorded in ART_BRIEF.md. No blueprint.
